People Ops: FYI team-wide org update + a couple of hires/backfills. TL;DR: Promotion, two backfills, one external hire intro. See details and links below. Please welcome and flag handoff questions.

People Ops: Promotion: Samir Das promoted to Director, Dedicated Capacity (effective 2024-12-02). Samir will own capacity SLAs, dedicated fleet roadmap, and customer escalation support for Dedicated customers. Congrats Samir! :tada:

Samir Das: Thank you! Excited to work more closely with infra and product on capacity reliability. Will set a short sync next week to align on priorities.

People Ops: Backfills: 1) Senior Eng (Dedicated Runtime) — internal post live today; interview loop fast-track. 2) Observability SRE — posting internal + external concurrently; hiring target 6 weeks.

Nina Rodriguez: Quick Q — who should I ping to coordinate Dedicated Runtime oncall handoffs for Samir's calendar?

People Ops: Nina please coordinate with Jon Park (eng-sre lead) for oncall coverage and with Samir for runbook handoff.

Jon Park: I can own the oncall rotation updates. Nina, let's set a 30-min handoff Thu.

People Ops: New hire intro: please welcome Lena Ortiz, joining next Monday as Senior PM, Model Onboarding (external hire). Lena comes from a background in LLM ops at a scale startup and will partner with product, serving runtime, and model onboarding teams.

Lena Ortiz: Hi everyone  excited to join Redwood Inference! I'll be scheduling 1:1s with adjacent teams in week one. Ping me if you have onboarding docs I should read.

Priya Menon: Welcome Lena! I'll share the model-onboarding prompt library and evaluation checklist.

People Ops Bot: New hire paperwork completed for Lena Ortiz. Welcome packet sent: <https://intranet.redwood.ai/welcome/lena_ortiz> :email:

People Ops: Handoff notes (short):
- Samirs expanded responsibilities include escalation triage and capacity roadmap sign-off.
- Dedicated Runtime backfill should prioritize low-latency kernel work and autoscaler gaps.
- Observability SRE post includes ownership of alert tuning and release tracing.

People Ops: Action items:
- Today: Hiring managers post interview slots and interview panel owners (if internal, tag people-ops).
- By Wed EOD: Samir & Jon confirm oncall rotation adjustments.
- By Fri: Hiring team share candidate rubric for Senior Eng role.

Samir Das: I'll circulate a short priority doc and add my availability for handoffs.

Nina Rodriguez: Meeting scheduled with Jon Thu 11:00am PT.

Jon Park: Added :calendar:. I'll update the rotation doc after the meeting.

Lena Ortiz: Thanks all  looking forward to meeting folks.

People Ops: Please react with :wave: to welcome Lena and :thumbsup: if you acknowledge the schedule changes.
